name: Constant Contact Module

suggests.drupal/block: Required to place the per-list signup blocks.
suggests.drupal/rest: Required for the optional signup REST endpoint.
suggests.drupal/webform: Required for the Constant Contact webform handler.
suggests.drupal/datetime: Required for birthday/anniversary and date custom fields.

project_description:
Constant Contact integration module using API v3.

 As of December 19, 2025, we have made the decision to discontinue maintenance of this module. The module is now set to seeking maintainers for anyone who would like to take over. For major bugs our team will attempt to assist as time allows. 

 You will need to create an application under your Constant contact account. Add the API and secret key to your settings.php file and generate tokens. 

 This project is not affiliated with Constant Contact and is not funded in any way by Constant Contact.

 

 Requirements
 
 
 Block module 
 RESTful Web Services and potentially REST UI modules (if wanting to use the provided REST endpoint) 
 Datetime module (if using custom date fields) 
 Webform (optional) - Use webform to submit data to an enabled Constant Contact list. 
 
 APIs supported 
 Constant Contact API v3 

 As of March 31, 2022 support will end for version 2.x due to an update to Constant Contact's authorization service . Please see upgrade instructions here .
